title: Imperial Star Destroyer — The Capture
description: A monumental Imperial dagger with faceted armor, recessed machinery trenches, eight twin turbolasers, a T-shaped command bridge and twin shield generators. Seven glowing ion engines dominate the stern. Beneath its ventral hangar, an eleven-engine blockade runner is being drawn aboard.
